item.content:encoded:
+ I REGRET NOTHING
-don't hate me ;-;

'Twas the night before Christmas, and at the Foundation
The researchers were having a celebration
Their stockings were placed in storage lockers with care
In hopes that 2412-J wouldn't find them there
The doctors were snoring all snug in their beds
While they dreamed dreams of SCP-682, dead.
And me, Agent [REDACTED], and researcher S████
Had just read another SCP report.
When, out of nowhere, I heard such a sound
That I jumped, hit my head, and fell back on the ground.
To the heavy containment door I flew like a flash,
Where it was simply torn open, nearly reduced to ash.
The light from within on the cold steel floor
Gave the illusion of a spaceship's opening door.
When what, to my wondering brain should behold,
But two-four-twelve-J-1, flying out, oh so bold.
With a creepy-ass driver, who I could immediately tell
Had to be SCP twenty four twelve.
Like bullets, some reindeer flew right by my face,
Who smashed through the wall, and flew off into space.
I raised the alarm, with a "CONTAINMENT BREACH!" yell,
Which was when things really started going to hell.
The skip came back around, he seemed quite insane.
Yelling and shouting some random-ass names.
Like Dasher and Dancer and Prancer and Vixen,
Or Comet, or Cupid, and Donner/Blitzen.
I figured he was calling out the reindeer's names.
But there were nine reindeer, and he only called eight.
And as I was pondering what they could mean,
He flew straight up, to the top of Site-19.
I wondered why people weren't flocking to him like sheep,
But when I looked around, everyone was asleep.
And suddenly, I heard a lot of smashes,
And he burst out of one of the ventilation hatches.
I pulled out my pistol, said "Freeze! Get on the ground!"
He grumbled, "What the fuck's with your chimney," with a frown.
He pulled out a pipe, and started to smoke.
I couldn't see anything, and began to choke.
I fell on the floor, and things started to fade,
And then later, I woke up on the next day.
Everybody woke up from their nappin',
And he was back in containment, like nothing had happened.
I later heard presents were spawning at a huge rate,
Somehow, out of SCP-038.
I knew what had happened, though no-one else did,
But for some reason, from everyone the truth I hid.
So remember, no matter what we expect,
Always keep this in mind: Secure. Contain. Protect.
